column3:
I tried to brush it clean.
The gray just kept coming
back.{page_break}It's in the water. It's
in the bread. It's in
everything.{end_wait}
If I'd known the sky\nwould turn on us, I'd\nhave buried it years ago.{end_wait}

The prisoners kept begging
to be let out before the
war in Tolbi started.{page_break}Colosso is a pit of
blood these days. People
bet on who survives.{end_wait}

Nobody came for the
thieves. Nobody came
for anyone.{page_break}Maybe the world's too
busy ending to bother.{end_wait}
Why would anyone want\nto be in Colosso now?\nThe dying don't need it.{end_wait}
Daddy stopped watching\nthe road. There's nobody\nleft to watch for.{end_wait}

They say Colosso runs
under the ash now.
I'd still like to see it.{page_break}Once more before I
die. It won't be long.{end_wait}

The warriors I saw at
Colosso were so strong.
Where are they now?{page_break}Dead, I'd guess. The
strong always go first.{end_wait}

My wife used to love
watching the gladiators.{page_break}Now I won't take her.
I won't watch her see
them bleed.{end_wait}

My husband talks about
Colosso all night.{page_break}I think it's the only
thing keeping him
from going mad.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!\nYou came back to Vault...\nI'm not sure why.{end_wait}
Since you left, the\nrain hasn't stopped and\nthe nights keep growing.{end_wait}
The thieves you caught\nbroke out of jail.\nNo one saw how.{end_wait}
We feared they'd hunt\nyou down. Have you seen\nthem?{end_now}
If a shadow moves where\nnothing should be there,\nit might be them. Run.{end_wait}
Good... But stay careful.\nSomething is watching\nthis town. I can feel it.{end_wait}
Those men wanted you\ndead. Keep your eyes open.{end_wait}
The mayor's family urn\nis on display. Go see it\nbefore the damp takes it.{end_wait}

You catch the thieves,
and we let them walk
right out the door.{page_break}We're a joke, and we
know it.{end_wait}

There's a festival in
some far-off town, they
say. In times like this?{page_break}People will cheer at
anything, if it keeps
them from the rain.{end_wait}
If we stay alert, they\nwon't surprise us.\n...I keep telling myself.{end_wait}
We'll lock it away soon.\nSome things are better\nhidden from the gray.{end_wait}
It's humiliating that the\nthieves slipped away.\nWe can't even guard a cell.{end_wait}
I used to love festivals.\nColosso must be a\nnightmare now.{end_wait}

There's a river of fire
on the far side of
Mt. Aleph.{page_break}Something broke open
there. Something that
won't close.{end_wait}
Imagine if it had\nhappened here. Maybe\nit's only a matter of time.{end_wait}

They say the volcano tore
our continent in two.{page_break}The Sol Sanctum's gone.
So is everyone who
was near it.{end_wait}

That crevasse split the
land, and kept the lava
from reaching us.{page_break}A mercy, if you can
call it that. The ash
came anyway.{end_wait}

No customers lately.
No one wants to buy
anything in the dark.{page_break}Maybe I'll close early
and sit with the lamp.{end_wait}
Why keep the store open?\nThe only thing I sell\nis candles.{end_wait}

Nothing to do. Nothing
to do. I hate it!{page_break}No one comes to the
village since the volcano.
Just gray and quiet.{end_wait}

We never get travelers
in winter, and this one
never seems to end.{page_break}Spring feels like a
story they tell
children now.{end_wait}
I made soup, so now I\nhave all these bones.{page_break}...You want some?{end_now}
You do? Really?\nTake as many as you like.\nThere's plenty left.{end_wait}
Right. Nobody can live\non bones alone, can they?{end_wait}
Won't anyone stay the\nnight? A thief would do.\nAnyone with a heartbeat.{end_wait}

After years in this trade
I used to believe good
times follow bad ones.{page_break}I'd like to believe it
again. It's hard now.{end_wait}
I hit a man in a rage\nand they locked me up.\nIt was stupid of me.{end_wait}
I need to master my\ntemper. It's the only\nthing I can still control.{end_wait}

The Silk Road's closed.
Nothing gets through.{page_break}If you're going to Tolbi,
you'll have to cross
the Karagol Sea.{end_wait}
With Silk Road shut,\neveryone's stranded.{page_break}Ship tickets cost more\nthan most of us have.{end_wait}

The road ends not far
from here. The ones who
go look come back silent.{page_break}They won't say what
they saw.{end_wait}
With Silk Road closed,\neveryone must go by ship.{page_break}The captain's getting\nrich off our fear.{end_wait}

Silk Road's shut, and
Colosso's started.{page_break}My daughter left Tolbi
to meet us at the docks.
I have a bad feeling.{end_wait}
We planned this trip for\na year. Then the world\nfell apart around it.{end_wait}
I hate charging this\nmuch for tickets. But\neveryone's desperate.{end_wait}
The captain's in a good\nmood. Frightened people\npay well.{end_wait}
Silk Road is blocked, so\nthe ship is packed with\nfrightened people.{end_wait}

So many passengers...
I wonder if the ship will
survive the crossing.{page_break}The sea looks wrong
these days.{end_wait}
